data.narrative:
Atlas Motion, a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by veterans of Shield AI and Mach Industries, has raised $11.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private and 1 public company in the robotics and manufacturing sector, though a narrow peer set limits the robustness of direct comparables.

Stage-progression methodology proves applicable and forms the primary valuation anchor. Using total capital raised ($12M) as a proxy for current valuation and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $29M. A peer-median approach was not viable; while 11 robotics peers exist in the broader sector, fewer than three companies matched narrow filters (same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier), making sector-wide median comparisons potentially misleading. Consequently, only the stage-progression method supplied a quantitative datapoint.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $24M to $33M, with a median point of $29M. This range reflects ±15% variance around the primary method. Key uncertainties include the absence of tightly comparable private transactions at this stage and valuation tier, and limited visibility into Atlas Motion's revenue, unit economics, or customer traction. A more granular range would require additional datapoints from recent Seed-stage robotics financings or revenue-based metrics from the target.
